### Observed differences

- Activity presence and frequency are essentially the same in both windows: A01 and A08 occur in every trace before and after, A12 in about 97 in 100 traces in both, and the optional activities appear in roughly one-third to one-half of traces in both windows, shifting by at most about five percentage points (for example A14 from 52% to 47%, A16 from 52% to 47%, A09 from 37% to 34%). Mean occurrences per trace move by at most about 0.08 (A01 from about 2.1 to 2.0). [OCC001, OCC004, OCC005, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010]
- Repeats become marginally less common: the share of traces in which an activity recurs falls by a few points for several activities (A08 from about 52 in 100 to 47, A16 from 39 to 34, A01 from 53 to 51), while A11 still occurs about 3.7 times per trace in roughly half of traces in both windows. [OCC001, OCC004, OCC006, OCC010]
- Successor mixes are nearly unchanged for most activities: after A08, A11 and A12 take about 40% and 43–44% of outgoing transitions in both windows; A11's own outgoing transitions split about 50/50 between A15 and A16 in both windows; A13 leads to A11 in essentially all cases (100% before, 98% after), as does A15 (about 98% in both). [DIR008, DIR011, DIR013, DIR015]
- The largest directional difference is at A12: before, of its 23 observed outgoing transitions, about 30% went to A05, 26% to A07, 22% to A04, 13% to A09 and 9% to A01; after, of 29 outgoing transitions, A07 takes only about 3%, while A01 and A09 rise to about 21% each and A05 to about 34%. This rests on roughly two dozen transitions per window, and about 31 in 100 random re-splits of stable windows produce a difference at least this large. [DIR012]
- Smaller routing wobbles of a few percentage points appear elsewhere, such as A02 → A06 falling from 10% to 4% of A02's outgoing transitions (A02 → A09 rising from 3% to 6%), and A05 → A11 falling from 17% to 10% while A05 → A08 rises from 33% to 40%. [DIR002, DIR005]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence
The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Participation, repetition and successor mixes differ only by a few percentage points between the two 200-trace windows, and the single larger shift — A12's followings moving away from A07 towards A01 and A09 — rests on only 23 versus 29 outgoing transitions with a moderate empirical strength, so sampling fluctuation between finite windows cannot be ruled out [DIR012].
